measured_on: Qt 6.8.3 macos qml tree, release variants only, client exclusions applied
note: The release audit enforces ZUI_MAX_CLIENT_ARCHIVE_MB (100 MiB) on the compressed client archive, which only a Linux client build can measure. This records the uncompressed QML payload of each root the client carries so the cost of registering a component's Qt module is visible in review, and so the total cannot drift past its budget across several PRs that cannot see each other.
